notes.d79_note_estimator: P_alpha = sum_block r psi_alpha with Euclidean-normalised rows; P_alpha = sqrt(B) * (1/B) sum_block r Phi_alpha, where B is the block size
notes.d79_block: complete factorial on the support axes with every other axis at its baseline level; the union over orders <= 3 is d79
notes.materiality: component share of the point's non-mean (centred) total sum of squares; alpha = 0.10
notes.precision_axis: four-level factor with rows mean, linear (-3,-1,1,3)/sqrt(5), quadratic (1,-1,-1,1)/2, cubic (-1,3,-3,1)/sqrt(5), orthonormal under the uniform measure over the four lanes
notes.far_region: x >= 31 is the single argument x = 32.  There the measured response is bit-identical across all 144 cells (checked and recorded as far_max_spread_across_cells = 0), so every contrast is mathematically zero; the ~1e-31 fp64 residues are summation roundoff.  Nonzero counts and order shares are reported both over all points and over regions A/B, and the A/B figures are the physical ones.
notes.d79_zero_counts: the verification note's 'exactly zero' counts (12/44, 11/44, 28/44, 28/44) are not reproduced by bit-exact zeros or by at-or-below-floor zeros of the note's P; both our counts and the note's are reported.  Its maxima, max relative and 10% material counts are reproduced exactly under the per-block maximum scale.
notes.d79_alias: the note's P_alpha is a block functional, not the pure component: it sums c_beta over every beta whose support contains alpha, weighted by baseline contrast values on the extra axes.  The alias split at each order-3 maximum is reported as self_term, alias_by_order, and self_fraction.
